gloss: to use properly according to situation; to use selectively

definitions.gloss: to use properly according to situation; to use selectively; to differentiate in usage
definitions.explanation: To choose and use different things or methods appropriately depending on the situation, purpose, or context.

examples.japanese: {敬語|けいご}と{普通|ふつう}{語|ご}を{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: To use honorific language and casual language appropriately.

examples.japanese: {場面|ばめん}によって{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to use different words depending on the situation.

examples.japanese: SNSのアカウントを{目的別|もくてきべつ}に{使|つか}い{分|わ}けている。
examples.english: I use different social media accounts for different purposes.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}/{下一段|しもいちだん})

CONJUGATION:
・{使|つか}い{分|わ}けない (negative)
・{使|つか}い{分|わ}けて (te-form)
・{使|つか}い{分|わ}けた (past)

COMMON OBJECTS:
・{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける - to use different words appropriately
・{敬語|けいご}を{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける - to use keigo appropriately
・{道具|どうぐ}を{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける - to use different tools for different purposes

NOUN FORM:
